packages.name: Char Dham Yatra 2026 — Dasara Special Offer
packages.destination: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath, with Haridwar, Lakhamandal, Uttarkashi, Sonprayag/Sitapur, Joshimath/Chamoli and Mana Village
packages.price: ₹23,499 per person + 5% GST, as printed in the supplied brochure. Current price and availability must be reconfirmed with the travel team.
departures: The brochure shows departure dates during August, September and October 2026. These are brochure dates only; confirm the next available batch with the travel team.
inclusions: AC transport from Delhi to Haridwar only; AC does not operate on the hills
Round-trip sleeper-class train reservation, subject to availability
Group-sharing rooms, generally 3- or 4-sharing according to group size and gender
Virtual travel manager available 24x7, as stated in the brochure
Tolls, parking, transport taxes, fuel charges and driver allowance
Travel insurance, as stated in the brochure
exclusions: Costs caused by natural calamities, landslides or roadblocks
Pony, doli and other trekking activity charges
Anything not mentioned in the inclusions
Government shared vehicle from Sonprayag to Gaurikund and personal cloakroom charges for luggage during the Kedarnath trek
Double-sharing upgrade: brochure states an additional ₹3,000 per person for 8 nights only; Kedarnath and Badrinath remain group-sharing
itinerary: Day 1: Delhi to Haridwar; visit Har Ki Pauri and attend Ganga Aarti; dinner and overnight hotel stay.
Day 2: Haridwar to Lakhamandal; visit Lakhamandal Shiva Temple; breakfast and dinner.
Day 3: Lakhamandal to Yamunotri via Janki Chatti; trek to Yamunotri and return; breakfast and dinner.
Day 4: Lakhamandal to Uttarkashi; visit Kashi Vishwanath Temple; breakfast and dinner.
Day 5: Uttarkashi to Gangotri and back; Gangotri Temple darshan; breakfast and dinner.
Day 6: Uttarkashi to Sonprayag or Sitapur; breakfast and dinner.
Day 7: Sonprayag/Sitapur to Kedarnath; approximately 22 km trek each way is described in the brochure; overnight at On A Trip camps; breakfast and dinner.
Day 8: Kedarnath darshan and trek down to Sonprayag/Sitapur; breakfast and dinner.
Day 9: Sonprayag/Sitapur to Badrinath/Joshimath; breakfast and dinner.
Day 10: Badrinath darshan, Tapt Kund and Mana Village sightseeing; overnight at Chamoli or Haridwar; breakfast and dinner.
Day 11: Depart for Delhi and drop-off; breakfast; yatra ends.
packages.notes: Brochure notes: Kedarnath camping has common washrooms and no private rooms. AC is available only at the Haridwar hotel; other hotels are non-AC. Guests should carry their own water bottle. Early departures apply for Kedarnath and Yamunotri, with packed breakfast. The company may modify the itinerary due to conditions. Trekking distances, transport, hotel allocation, price, taxes, departure dates and availability must be reconfirmed before booking. The brochure lists package price ₹23,499 + 5% GST and a normal price ₹29,999; do not promise the offer is still active.

faqs.question: What is included in the Char Dham Yatra package?
faqs.answer: The brochure lists Delhi–Haridwar AC transport (AC does not operate on hills), round-trip sleeper train reservation subject to availability, group-sharing stays across the itinerary, 10 breakfasts, 10 dinners, sightseeing and darshans, a virtual travel manager, transport-related charges and travel insurance. Please reconfirm the current inclusions with our travel team before booking.

faqs.question: What is excluded from the Char Dham Yatra package?
faqs.answer: The brochure excludes personal expenses, pony/doli and trekking activity charges, tips, heater charges, hot water at Kedarnath, certain natural-calamity/roadblock costs and anything not listed in inclusions. Government shared transport to Gaurikund and luggage cloakroom charges are also described as at the traveller’s own cost. Our travel team can confirm the current details.

faqs.question: What services do you provide?
faqs.answer: On A Trip Holidays helps with tour packages, customized trips, hotel bookings, and flight bookings. Tell me your destination and travel dates so I can check the available package information.

faqs.question: How do I book a trip?
faqs.answer: I can help you find the right package. Please share your destination, travel dates, and number of travellers. Our travel team will confirm availability and the next booking steps.

faqs.question: Are package prices final?
faqs.answer: Package prices and any applicable taxes must be checked against the specific package details. I won’t guess or promise an unverified price. If the amount isn’t listed, I’ll confirm with our travel team. A travel expert will let you know, sir.
